title: A12 STARDUST ISOTOPE FOUNDRY engineering data contract
description: Proposed record contract. No data have been collected by this generator. Null is missing/unknown and must be qualified in the separate provenance record.

source_grid_id.x-quality-rule: Mass basis and absent isotopes explicit.

isotope_counts.x-quality-rule: Nonnegative; no missing isotope replaced zero.

beam_fraction.x-quality-rule: Between zero and one; definition recorded.

mass50_correction.x-encoding: Structured JSON record; member names, frames and mandatory subfields must be frozen in the project ICD before ingestion.

ratio_covariance.x-quality-rule: Symmetric positive semidefinite; denominator correlations retained.

x-unit-policy: Use documented units; do not replace missing values with zero. Reference frames, covariance basis, calibration version and quality qualifiers reside in the provenance sidecar.
x-domain-validation: Physical range, covariance validity and declared quality rules require domain validation beyond JSON Schema.
